Utilization ~85% is somewhat elevated but there's ~$1.9M available liquidity, and the user's position is only $1,000, so withdrawal is trivially possible. Contract running, withdrawals enabled. This is normal-ish; high utilization means good yield for suppliers, slight liquidity tightness but not a problem for a $1k position.

Could argue "elevated" due to utilization near 85%? For a no-debt supplier, high utilization is actually beneficial (higher deposit yield) and only matters if it goes to ~100% and withdrawals become constrained. With ledger-available $1.9M, no issue. I'll say low, hold.
